B.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including improper fractions) and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and the work only subtracts numerators
Work stays in mixed-number form with like denominators and does not need an LCD step

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they are expressed with a common denominator (including the like-denominator case).
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs fraction subtraction with a shared denominator (e.g., a/b − c/b)
Solution subtracts after converting to a common denominator (may be shown as a single subtraction step)
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed
Only conversion/simplification is performed without actually subtracting the fractions

skills.name: Mixed/improper rewriting
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers, whole numbers, or improper mixed forms into an equivalent form (improper fraction or whole+fraction with a chosen denominator) to enable subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Convert a mixed number to an improper fraction (or interpret an improper mixed number like 2 3/2 as a sum)
Rewrite a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 = 12/3) or as a mixed number with a fractional part (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3)
exclusion_criteria: Only finding an LCD and converting proper fractions (that is S01)
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction after subtraction (that is S04)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow between whole and fractional parts when needed and express the final answer in simplest form (reduce and/or convert to integer/mixed number).
inclusion_criteria: Borrow/regroup because the fractional subtraction is negative (e.g., add b/b after borrowing 1 from the whole)
Reduce a fraction to lowest terms (including turning 0/b into 0)
Convert an improper fraction result to a mixed number (or combine whole+fraction into a final form)
exclusion_criteria: Straight fraction subtraction with no borrowing and no simplification beyond the subtraction step
Only common-denominator conversion (S01) or only rewriting inputs (S03) without any regrouping/simplifying of the result

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers (including improper mixed forms) and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already share a denominator and no conversion is performed
Work is done by converting mixed numbers to improper fractions with the same denominator (no LCD step shown)

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they have the same denominator (including cases yielding 0 or a negative fraction).
inclusion_criteria: Solution subtracts numerators over a common denominator (a/b − c/b)
Solution performs the fraction subtraction after an LCD conversion or within mixed-number fraction parts
exclusion_criteria: Only whole-number subtraction is performed with no fractional subtraction shown
Only simplification/reduction is performed without a subtraction operation

skills.name: Mixed number handling
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed numbers (including improper mixed forms like 2 3/2) into a workable form (improper fraction or separated whole+fraction) and combine whole and fractional parts in the final result.
inclusion_criteria: Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction using (whole·denominator + numerator)/denominator
Solution interprets an improper mixed form as whole + improper fraction (e.g., 1 4/3 = 1 + 4/3)
Solution combines a computed whole part and fractional part into a mixed-number result
exclusion_criteria: Problem involves only proper fractions with no whole part present
Borrowing/regrouping is the only mixed-number-related action (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regrouping and simplifying
skills.definition: Regroup/borrow between whole and fractional parts when needed and simplify the final numeric form (reduce fractions and/or convert 0/denominator to 0).
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part to make the fractional subtraction nonnegative (adds denominator/denominator)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a mixed number with a fractional part to enable subtraction (e.g., 2 = 1 3/3)
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms or simplifies to an integer/0
exclusion_criteria: Only common-denominator conversion is done (tag S01)
Only straightforward fraction subtraction with no borrowing and no simplification is shown

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers and simplifying results

skills.name: Common denominator conversion
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator (LCD) and rewrite one or both fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution explicitly finds an LCD/LCM of denominators
Solution converts fractions to equivalent forms with a common denominator before subtracting
exclusion_criteria: Fractions already have the same denominator and no conversion is performed
Only simplifying/reducing a fraction is done (e.g., 4/10 to 2/5) without creating a common denominator for subtraction

skills.name: Subtract fractions
skills.definition: Subtract two fractions once they share a common denominator (including like-denominator cases) by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Solution performs fraction subtraction in the form a/b − c/b = (a−c)/b
Solution subtracts after converting to a common denominator
exclusion_criteria: Only subtracting whole-number parts of mixed numbers without subtracting fractional parts
Only regrouping/borrowing is performed without completing the fraction subtraction

skills.name: Mixed-number subtraction setup
skills.definition: Rewrite mixed/whole numbers into a form suitable for subtraction (separating whole and fractional parts or converting to improper fractions, including rewriting a whole number as a fraction with a chosen denominator).
inclusion_criteria: Solution converts a mixed number to an improper fraction (e.g., 4 1/3 → 13/3)
Solution rewrites a whole number as a fraction with a specified denominator (e.g., 4 → 12/3, or 2 → 1 3/3)
Solution separates mixed numbers into whole-part subtraction and fraction-part subtraction (including using 0/b for missing fractional parts)
exclusion_criteria: Both numbers are already simple fractions and no mixed/whole rewriting is needed
Only borrowing/regrouping is done after an initial subtraction attempt (tag S04 instead)

skills.name: Regroup and simplify result
skills.definition: Regroup (borrow) from the whole part when the fractional subtraction is negative and/or simplify the final numeric form by reducing fractions and expressing 0 or a mixed number appropriately.
inclusion_criteria: Solution borrows 1 from the whole part and adds b/b to the fractional part to make subtraction possible
Solution reduces a fraction to lowest terms (e.g., 9/12 → 3/4) or simplifies 0/b → 0
Solution recombines whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number or integer after regrouping
exclusion_criteria: Only finding a common denominator or subtracting numerators without any regrouping or simplification
Converting mixed numbers to improper fractions without any borrowing or final-form simplification
